jobs.occupation: Senior Cost Estimator, EMEA Infrastructure Development - (m/w/d) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

The EMEA Infrastructure Development team is seeking a Senior Cost Estimator to serve as the subject matter expert in construction cost estimating across Tesla's EMEA portfolio, including Service Centers, Retail Stores, Delivery Hubs, and Non-SSD sites (R&D, Training, Offices, etc.) You will drive the transition from decentralized regional estimating to a centralized EMEA-wide approach — defining the methodology, standards, templates, and governance for how projects are evaluated. You will deliver independent, reliable construction cost estimates at every project stage, giving project teams, designers, procurement, and leadership a trusted reference for go/no-go decisions.

What You’ll Do

- Develop cost estimates from Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) through detailed CapEx budgets, with accuracy appropriate to each project stage (AACE estimate classes as reference framework)
- Produce high-level estimates based on historic data to support go/no-go decisions against key cost metrics
- Analyze plans, Due diligence reports and interpret designs; perform dimensional quantity take-offs; identify scope implied but not explicitly shown in design documents
- Develop and manage a Basis of Estimate for each project — scope, execution strategy, precision level, assumptions, exclusions, risks, and critical information
- Lead value engineering at early design stages, providing cost-driven feedback and recommendations to designers
- Visit project sites as required to validate scope, site conditions, and constraints in support of estimation — working from assumptions and scope definition provided by the Project Manager, Real Estate team and design team
- Support the Procurement and PMs with contractor pricing validation and bid leveling to ensure we are receiving good value for spends
- Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating processes
- Maintain and update the cost database, ensuring pricing reflects current market conditions, inflation, transport costs, and regional differentiation
- Deliver accurate, independently validated estimates to support ATP and go/no-go decisions; review outputs against historic pricing and regional benchmarks
- Provide expert input to Procurement on sourcing and pricing for atypical works or high cost-variance items

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or related field — or equivalent professional experience
- 5+ years as a senior specialist or SME in project cost estimating, preferably in retail, commercial, industrial, or multi-site infrastructure rollout environments
- Practical knowledge of construction means and methods across civil, structural, architectural, MEP disciplines with the ability to translate technical knowledge into accurate, defensible cost advice
- Solid understanding of CapEx cost estimating from ROM through detailed CapEx budgeting; proven experience with quantity take-offs and design document interpretation
- Experience maintaining or developing pricing databases or cost libraries at a portfolio or multi-country level
- Ability of identifying main risks especially during ROM which could significantly impact the costs in a later stage
- Analytical, detail-oriented, and self-motivated; proactive communicator in a fast-paced, multicultural environment
- Experience building, leading, or transitioning to a centralized estimating function — methodology, SOPs, and standardization frameworks
- Proven track record as the go-to cost expert for project teams, designers, and leadership; authoritative cost advice with confidence, independence, and sound professional judgement
- Availability to travel across EMEA as required (up to 50%)
- English required; additional European language skills a strong plus

jobs.employer_name: Leibniz-Institut für Agrartechnik und Bioökonomie e.V.
jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute for Agricultural Engineering and Bioeconomy (ATB) is a pioneer and a driver of bioeconomy research. We create the scientific foundation to transform agricultural, food, industrial and energy systems into a sustainable bio-based circular economy. We develop and integrate techniques, processes and management strategies, effectively converging technologies to intelligently crosslink highly diverse bioeconomic production systems and to control them in a knowledge-based, adaptive and largely automated manner. We conduct research in dialogue with society, policymakers, industry and other stakeholders - knowledge-driven and application-inspired.

To support Economics of Technologies in Agriculture in the Technology Assessment Department we are seeking, at the earliest possible date a

Doctoral researcher (m/f/d) (75 %)

for the research area

„Economic analysis of innovative fenland use“

The economic analysis includes various lines of utilization of biomass from wet fenland sites and analysis of greenhouse gas abatement potentials resulting from the change in land use. Cost analysis includes approaches and cost estimates for planning, permission, management, and harvest of mixed vegetation, storage and transportation, and processing in innovative biomass utilization pathways. Labor times, costs, and potential savings from autonomous harvesting vehicles, among others, are identified. Reference uses and innovative business models are also considered to determine the economic viability of specific processes.

The aim of the project is to create a network of model and demonstration projects for the use of rewetted fens with representative fen areas, biomass utilization pathways and relevant actors in Brandenburg. Partners are in addition to ATB the Brandenburg State Office for the Environment (LfU), the University for Sustainable Development Eberswalde (HNEE), the Leibniz Centre for Agricultural Landscape Research (ZALF) and the Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences (GFZ). The WetNetBB network is part of a network of model and demonstration projects (PaludiNet) coordinated by the Thünen Institute (TI) and Greifswald Moor Centrum (GMC) as PaludiCenter. The position is assigned to the Technology Assessment Department at the ATB, and close cooperation with the Systems Process Engineering Department is intended. 

Yourtasks

- Development of models for calculating the economic potential of different utilization systems on wet fenlands
- Recording and analysis of the labour time requirements of novel forms of use of wet fenlands
- Quantitative and qualitative evaluation of scientific results
- Development of scenario-based calculations of the costs of agricultural use through paludiculture on lowland bog sites
- Presentation of project results at scientific conferences and stakeholder meetings
- Writing of scientific publications and project reports

Your qualifications

- Very good university degree in agricultural economics or related subjects (Diploma or Master of Science)
- Knowledge and experience in economic analysis of agricultural systems
- Knowledge in statistical data analysis
- Strong interest in interdisciplinary collaboration
- Very good knowledge of written and spoken English
- Very good knowledge of German for communication with stakeholders and farmers
- Ability to work in a team and willingness to cooperate, reliability, flexibility, personal commitment and independent working skills
- EU driving license class B desirable

We offer

- Encouragement and support for PhD candidates in pursuing their doctoral studies in collaboration with partner universities
- An attractive, research-intensive, and interdisciplinary working environment
- A varied position at the interface of science and practice
- Excellent infrastructure for scientific work
- Access to national and international networks for your scientific development
- Training and further education opportunities
- Family-friendly working conditions to promote work-life balance
- Participation in the VBB company ticket or Deutschlandticket
- A workplace at the edge of a picturesque landscape, easily accessible by bike or public transport

The part-time position (30 hours/week) is initially limited to 4 years. Salary will be based on your qualifications and experience according to TV-L up to pay grade E 13.

For further information, please contact Dr. Andreas Meyer-Aurich (phone +49 331 5699-222) and visit our website at www.atb-potsdam.de (http://www.atb-potsdam.de) .

Have we piqued your interest? Then apply by 30 September 2026 with your cover letter, CV (without photo), and employment references and/or contact details of referees via our online application portal for this job posting (reference number 2026-TA-3) at www.atb-potsdam.de/en/career/vacancies (http://www.atb-potsdam.de/en/career/vacancies) . 

As a certified family-friendly institute, the ATB is committed to equal opportunities and diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnic or social background, age, religion, disability, or sexual identity. Applications from people with severe disabilities are particularly encouraged and will be given preference in the event of equal qualifications.

The ATB aims to increase the proportion of women among doctoral researchers and therefore explicitly encourages applications from women.

We are IT security specialists: our products encrypt business communications. More than 25% of the 100 highest-revenue companies in Germany, as well as hundreds of medium-sized enterprises across all industries, already use our Z1 encryption solutions. We have big plans and continue to grow steadily. Nearly 140 employees are already working with us in Neukölln. Join our professional, highly qualified team: take on challenges, share your knowledge, learn new things, and discover your potential!

Your tasks

Are you well organized, reliable, and enjoy making sure everything runs smoothly within a team? As a Team Assistant, you will take responsibility for coordination, documentation, and a variety of organizational tasks. By doing so, you will enable our Product Management team to focus on strategy, discovery, and delivery.

- You will coordinate tasks, timelines, and dependencies around our software releases, while also taking ownership of recurring release-related activities.
- You will research new tools and other relevant topics, presenting your findings in a clear and structured way so the team can make well-informed decisions quickly.
- You will keep our team documentation, templates, and process descriptions up to date and well organized.
- You will support the preparation and recording of product demos.
- You will reliably organize internal meetings, document decisions and next steps, and ensure that agreed action items are followed up.
- You will independently manage smaller internal projects and drive them through to successful completion.

Your profile

- You have completed a commercial or administrative apprenticeship, hold a relevant degree, or possess a comparable qualification.
- You have at least two years of experience as a Team Assistant, Project Coordinator, or in a similar role.
- You work in a structured, meticulous, and self-driven manner.
- Even when managing multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously, you stay organized and consistently follow through on open items until completion.
- You quickly absorb information and organize it in a logical and meaningful way.
- You communicate clearly, professionally, and with confidence.
- You have an interest in software products and are eager to familiarize yourself with technical and product-related topics.
- Excellent written and spoken English completes your profile.

Nice to have

- Good German language skills
- Experience working in a software or technology company
- Proficiency with tools such as Confluence, Jira, YouTrack, or similar applications

We offer

- Flexible hours and home office options
- Mobility: free Germany-wide public transport ticket, bike leasing, or parking
- Subsidies for meals: (e.g., delivery services) and home office internet
- Urban Sports Club membership for flexible fitness and wellness
- Office perks: rooftop terraces & green courtyard, organic fruit and drinks, personal packages accepted at the office
- Get-togethers: monthly Pizza Friday, regular team events, big summer party
- Responsible leadership: structured onboarding, regular feedback, clear goals
- Innovative without startup risk: profitable for 20+ years, self-funded innovation with strong global potential
- International team: 120+ colleagues from 30+ countries, open and collaborative culture

If that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you.

Want to know more? Please have a look at our Work at Zertificon page: https://www.zertificon.com/en/it-jobs-berlin/work-at-zertificon (https://www.zertificon.com/en/it-jobs-berlin/work-at-zertificon)

Help Accelerate Industrial Decarbonization

Join exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.

As our Electrical Drive & Controls Engineer, you'll help bring our solar thermal technology to life by developing, integrating, testing, and maintaining the electrical drive and control systems behind our innovative collector technology.

Working alongside Mechanical, Structural and Software Engineers, you'll play a hands-on role in building prototypes, developing test benches, integrating electrical hardware with control software, and validating new solutions before they are deployed in industrial-scale projects.

Your Impact

The systems you build and test will directly improve the reliability, performance, and efficiency of GlassPoint's solar thermal technology.

By combining practical engineering with close collaboration across disciplines, you'll help ensure our innovations perform reliably in the laboratory, during testing, and ultimately in the field.

What You'll Do

Build & Integrate Electrical Systems

- Support the development and integration of electrical drive systems for our solar thermal technology.
- Install, wire, commission, and maintain electrical and control components for prototypes and engineering test benches.
- Troubleshoot electrical systems and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Support Controls & Software Development

- Work closely with software and controls engineers to develop and validate drive and control systems.
- Integrate electrical hardware with control software for prototypes and test benches.
- Support commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization of drive and control systems during testing.
- Assist with functional testing and validation to ensure reliable system performance.

Develop and Maintain Test Systems

- Design, build, install, and maintain electrical systems for engineering test benches supporting the development and validation of our solar thermal components and subsystems.
- Prepare and execute functional testing of electrical drives, control systems, and other electromechanical components.
- Analyse test results and recommend improvements to system performance and reliability.

Collaborate Across Engineering

- Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to solve technical challenges.
- Support prototype assembly, commissioning, and field testing where required.
- Contribute to technical documentation, engineering standards, and continuous product improvement.

Who You Are

You're someone who enjoys getting hands-on with hardware and solving practical engineering challenges. You like building, wiring, testing, troubleshooting, and continuously improving electrical systems, and you're comfortable working both in the workshop and alongside multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Ideally, you'll bring:

- A degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
- 5+ years of experience developing, integrating, and testing electrical drive and control systems in an industrial environment.
- Hands-on experience wiring, commissioning, troubleshooting, and validating electrical equipment and test systems.
- Experience integrating electrical hardware with control software; experience developing or modifying basic control software is an advantage.
- Experience with PLCs, servo drives, motion control systems, or industrial automation.
- The ability to read electrical schematics and technical drawings.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a practical, structured approach.
- Fluency in English; German is an advantage.
- Willingness to travel occasionally to suppliers and project sites.

What You'll Find at GlassPoint

- Meaningful responsibility from day one and the opportunity to make a real impact.
- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.
- Complex engineering challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.
- A highly collaborative environment where your work moves quickly from concept to real-world application.
- Opportunities to grow your technical expertise through cross-functional projects and international collaboration.
- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization.

At GlassPoint, we believe that different perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our teams. We are committed to providing an inclusive working environment where everyone is treated with respect, feels valued, and has the opportunity to contribute their best work.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, ethnic or social background, nationality, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We have zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation.

GlassPoint helps heavy industry decarbonize by replacing fuel-based steam with solar thermal heat. This reduces energy costs and improves long-term energy security.  We’re a proven technology, already operating some of the world’s largest solar steam projects across sun-belt regions in oil and gas, metals, and mining.

Your profile

Your motivation

Are you looking for new challenges in a highly competitive environment? And you want to tackle them creatively and on your own responsibility? Do you prefer a "get-it-done" culture and think in terms of solutions rather than problems? What are you waiting for? We would be happy to explain our corporate benefits in a personal conversation

jobs.occupation: PhD Candidate in Functional Genomics and Pancreatic Cancer Research; part time 65%  (m/w/d) (Forschungsreferent/in)
jobs.description:
Scope of duties

· Work on the project “Global mapping of drug synergy landscapes using massively parallel Cas13d genetic interaction screening” within the German Cancer Aid-funded DEFEAT-PDAC consortium
· Investigate therapeutically relevant genetic dependencies and drug combinations in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
· Perform and analyze high-throughput genetic interaction screens, particularly using Cas13d-based screening approaches
· Plan and conduct molecular and cell biological experiments to validate identified targets and drug synergies
· Investigate rational combination therapies, including combinations with RAS/KRAS inhibitors
· Work with pancreatic cancer cell lines and additional preclinical model systems
· Apply modern methods in cell biology, molecular biology, functional genomics and proteomics
· Quantitatively analyze, interpret and document experimental data
· Collaborate closely with research groups and technology platforms within the DEFEAT-PDAC network
· Present research findings at project meetings and scientific conferences and contribute to scientific publications

Our requirements

· A successfully completed university degree, preferably a Master’s degree or equivalent, in biology, biochemistry, molecular medicine, biotechnology or a related life-science discipline
· Strong interest in cancer biology, functional genomics, mechanisms of therapy resistance and translational cancer research
· Practical experience in cell and molecular biology, for example mammalian cell culture, transfection, RNA and protein analysis, immunoblotting or microscopy
· Previous experience with CRISPR-based technologies, genetic screens, proteomics, next-generation sequencing or bioinformatic data analysis is an advantage, but not mandatory
· Motivation to learn new experimental technologies and quantitative analysis methods
· A careful, structured and independent approach to scientific work
· Scientific curiosity, high motivation and enthusiasm for experimental research
· Strong communication and teamwork skills and an interest in working in an interdisciplinary and international research environment
· Very good written and spoken English
· German language skills are not required

Our offer

· An innovative and challenging PhD project within the DEFEAT-PDAC consortium, a national and internationally connected research network funded by German Cancer Aid

· An international and interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of cancer biology, functional genomics, proteomics and clinical translation
· State-of-the-art laboratories and access to advanced screening, proteomics, sequencing and data-analysis platforms
· Close collaboration with basic scientists, bioinformaticians and clinician scientists
· Structured scientific supervision and support for your professional and personal development
· Opportunities to participate in national and international conferences, workshops and training programmes
· A collaborative, supportive and inspiring working environment that encourages scientific independence and the development of your own ideas
· Employment according to the German public-sector collective agreement, including annual leave and additional benefits in accordance with the applicable regulations
· The position is initially funded for three years. Subject to a positive scientific re-evaluation, an extension for up to two additional years is possible
· The position is based at the LMU University Hospital, Campus Großhadern, in Munich
· The remuneration is based on the Collective Agreement for the Public Service of the Federal States (TV-Ärzte) including all allowances customary in the public service.

jobs.occupation: PhD Candidate in Translational Pancreatitis and Thromboinflammation Research; part time 65  (m/w/d) (Forschungsreferent/in)
jobs.description:
Scope of duties

· Work on the Collaborative Research Centre project (SFB) “Thromboinflammatory mechanisms of pancreatitis progression and associated splanchnic and portal vein thrombosis”
· Investigate cellular and molecular mechanisms that link pancreatic inflammation, coagulation and thrombotic complications
· Study the role of platelet–neutrophil interactions and sphingolipid metabolism in acute and acute-on-chronic pancreatitis
· Plan and perform experimental studies using cellular systems, patient-derived biosamples and established preclinical models of pancreatitis
· Apply modern molecular, biochemical and cell biological methods, including cell culture, flow cytometry, immunofluorescence microscopy, RNA and protein analysis and functional cellular assays
· Contribute to the characterization of inflammatory, thrombotic and metabolic pathways using proteomic, lipidomic or transcriptomic approaches
· Participate in the development and validation of targeted therapeutic strategies, including nanoparticle- and aptamer-based delivery approaches
· Quantitatively analyze, interpret and document experimental and clinical research data
· Collaborate closely with scientists, clinicians and technology platforms within the interdisciplinary Collaborative Research Centre
· Present research findings at internal meetings and national and international scientific conferences and contribute to scientific publications

Our requirements

· A successfully completed university degree, preferably a Master’s degree or equivalent, in biology, biochemistry, molecular medicine, biotechnology, pharmacy or a related life-science discipline
· Strong interest in translational research, inflammation, pancreatitis, vascular biology or immunology
· Practical experience in molecular and cell biology, for example mammalian cell culture, flow cytometry, microscopy, immunoblotting, quantitative PCR or functional cellular assays
· Previous experience with primary cells, patient samples, animal models, proteomics, lipidomics, nanoparticles or drug-delivery systems is an advantage, but not mandatory
· Motivation to learn new experimental technologies and quantitative analysis methods
· A careful, structured and reliable approach to experimental work
· Scientific curiosity, high motivation and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team
· Strong communication skills and enthusiasm for working in an interdisciplinary and international research environment
· Very good written and spoken English
· German language skills are not required

Our offer

· An innovative PhD project within an interdisciplinary Collaborative Research Centre at LMU University Hospital

· A translational research environment combining experimental pancreatitis research, vascular biology, immunology and clinical medicine
· The opportunity to work with patient-derived biosamples, established disease models and modern molecular and imaging technologies
· State-of-the-art laboratories and access to advanced flow cytometry, microscopy, proteomics, lipidomics and data-analysis platforms
· Close collaboration with basic scientists, clinician scientists, bioinformaticians and experts in vascular and inflammatory biology
· Integration into a highly collaborative national research network with opportunities for scientific exchange across several disciplines
· Structured scientific supervision and support for professional and personal development
· Opportunities to participate in scientific workshops, training programmes and national and international conferences
· A supportive and inspiring working environment that encourages scientific independence and the development of new ideas
· Employment according to the German public-sector collective agreement, including annual leave and additional benefits in accordance with the applicable regulations
· The position is initially limited to three years. The precise wording regarding a possible extension should be adapted to the SFB funding conditions
· The position is based at LMU University Hospital, Campus Großhadern, in Munich
· Remuneration is based on the Collective Agreement for the Public Sector of the Länder (TV-L) including all allowances customary in the public sector.

jobs.occupation: Senior HR Administration Specialist – Compensation & Payroll (m/f/d) (Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter/in)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty. We're looking for a Senior HR Administration Specialist with deep expertise in compensation and payroll to build the strategic and operational backbone TYTAN’s compensation plan

This is not a purely administrative role. You'll be the internal expert on compensation structure, payroll accuracy, and benefits strategy, running a flawless day-to-day payroll operations, you will also act as a key point of contact for employees, managers, HR, Finance, and external payroll providers, ensuring payroll and compensation data is accurate, processes are well controlled, and employee queries are resolved efficiently. This role is ideal for someone strong payroll expertise with excellent attention to detail, analytical skills, and a service-oriented approach.

Your Roadmap to make an Impact

Compensation Strategy & Benchmarking

- Build and maintain TYTAN's salary benchmarking framework, ensuring pay ranges are competitive, internally consistent, and grounded in real market data
- Design a scalable compensation model and leveling approach that can support TYTAN's growth over the next several years, not just its current headcount
- Continuously benchmark and compare benefits offerings against market standards, recommending adjustments to stay competitive as TYTAN scales
- Partner with leadership on compensation decisions for new hires, promotions, and salary reviews, bringing data-backed recommendations rather than ad hoc judgment calls

Payroll Operations

- Own end-to-end monthly payroll processing in coordination with external payroll providers/tax advisors, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
- Maintain and update employee master data relevant to payroll and compensation (contracts, salary changes, benefits, terminations, parental leave, etc.)
- Ensure full payroll compliance with German labor law, tax regulations, and social security requirements

Benefits

- Own TYTAN's benefits offering end-to-end administration, employee communication, and ongoing evaluation against market benchmarks
- Identify and recommend new or improved benefits as part of the broader compensation strategy

Tools, Process & Reporting

- Evaluate, implement, and/or optimize HR/payroll systems to support compensation and payroll processes as TYTAN scales
- Prepare reports and analytics on payroll costs, compensation trends, and benefits utilization for People Ops, Finance, and leadership
- Support internal and external audits related to payroll and compensation
- Build and document scalable compensation and payroll processes, since much of this infrastructure is still being established at TYTAN

Job requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
- 5+ years of relevant experience in HR administration, payroll, compensation, or a similar role.
- Strong hands-on experience with end-to-end payroll processes.
- Experience working with HRIS and payroll systems; Datev is a plus.
- Good understanding of compensation principles and payroll-related legislation.
- Strong Excel skills, including data analysis, reconciliations, and reporting.
- Experience working with confidential and sensitive employee information.
- Experience coordinating with Finance, payroll providers, and other internal/external stakeholders.
- Fluency in German and English is required

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are looking for a Senior Procurement Specialist to define and execute the long-term procurement strategy for our operations. This role goes beyond transactional purchasing and focuses on supplier strategy, cost optimization, risk management, and scalability, supporting both current production and future growth. You will work closely with Manufacturing, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Finance, and Operations, ensuring a resilient, cost-effective, and scalable supply base.

Your roadmap to make an impact

Procurement Strategy & Supplier Management

- Develop and execute sourcing strategies for key commodities, components, and services.
- Select, onboard and manage global suppliers, building long-term strategic partnerships.
- Monitor supplier performance and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Cost, Risk & Contract Management

- Lead cost reduction and value engineering initiatives in collaboration with Engineering and Manufacturing.
- Lead supplier negotiations for contracts and commercial agreements.
- Identify, manage and mitigate supply chain risks through effective contingency and risk mitigation plans.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Act as the procurement interface to Manufacturing, Engineering, Finance, Quality, and Operations for selected commodities and projects.
- Support new product introductions and supplier readiness.
- Coordinate procurement activities to ensure material availability.

Process Improvement

- Support procurement processes and KPI reporting.
- Maintain supplier documentation and contracts.
- Contribute to procurement system and process improvements.

Job requirements

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field
- 3 - 6 years of experience in strategic procurement or supply chain management, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial environment
- Proven experience managing strategic suppliers and complex sourcing initiatives
- Strong negotiation, analytical, and commercial skills
- Solid understanding of manufacturing processes and cost drivers
- Experience supporting NPI, production ramp-ups, and scaling operations
- Structured, data-driven working style with a high sense of ownership
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Experience with ERP and procurement systems (e.g. SAP) is a plus
- Fluency in German and English is required
